name: Moreconvert Message Hub
author: Moreconvert Team

sections.description:
MoreConvert Message Hub transforms your WordPress site into a fully-featured notification center. Whether you need to send system alerts, WooCommerce order updates, comment notifications, or custom messages, this plugin provides a clean, efficient solution.

Key Features (Free Version)

  • In‑App Notification Center – A dedicated message dashboard accessible via WooCommerce My Account or a custom URL.
  • Real‑Time Updates – Live message counts with AJAX and WordPress Heartbeat API support.
  • Multi‑Trigger System – Send notifications automatically based on various events.
    • Comment Triggers – Notify users when someone replies to their comment or when their comment is approved.
    • User Events Trigger – Send notifications for user registration, login/logout, and password reset events. Fully customizable with role‑based recipient selection.
    • Post Published Trigger – Automatically notify users when a new post is published. Supports selecting post types and recipient roles, with fallback to all users.
    • Manual Messages – Send custom messages to individual users, user roles, or all users from the admin panel.
    • Developer‑Friendly API – Hook into moreconvert_messages_send to trigger notifications programmatically.
    • Custom Trigger Types – Create limited custom trigger types for any event.
  • User‑Friendly Interface – Clean, modern message tabs with icons and pagination.
  • Shortcode Support:
    • [moreconvert_messages]: Display a paginated notification list with tabs for different types.
    • [moreconvert_messages_counter]: Show a counter for unread notifications.
  • Customizable Styling – Control colors, fonts, and icon styles from the admin panel.
  • WooCommerce My Account Integration – Native integration with the WooCommerce dashboard.
  • WordPress Menu Integration – Add the message counter to any WordPress navigation menu.
  • Message Expiration – Set expiration dates for messages (auto‑deactivates expired messages).
  • Flatsome Theme Integration – Add the message counter to Flatsome Header Builder with full customizer support.
  • CRON Cleanup – Automatic cleanup of old messages (customizable per trigger).
  • WPML & Polylang Compatible – Translation‑ready with full WPML support.

Premium Features

Upgrade to MoreConvert Message Hub Pro to unlock advanced capabilities:

  • Integrations –
    • AutomatorWP Integration – Create powerful automation workflows with AutomatorWP actions (Send Message action available).
    • OneSignal Push Notifications – Send push notifications to users via OneSignal alongside in‑app messages.
  • Modules –
    • Webhook Receiver – Secure REST API endpoint to receive messages from external automation platforms (n8n, Make, Zapier, Integromat, etc.).
    • User Preferences – Allow users to customize which notification types they receive (opt‑in/out per trigger).
    • Weekly Digest – Send scheduled weekly email digests of unread messages to users.
    • Analytics & Reporting – Track message impressions, clicks, and CTR per trigger type with visual dashboards and export capabilities.
  • Triggers –
    • WooCommerce Order Status Triggers – Send notifications for order status changes.
    • WooCommerce Coupon Triggers – Notify users when new coupons are published.
    • MoreConvert Pro Integration – Sync waitlist events: back in stock, price change, on sale, low stock, plus automation and email campaign notifications.
    • Custom Trigger Types – Create unlimited custom trigger types for any event.
  • Advanced Styling – Additional style controls for the message counter and notification center.
  • Priority Support – Get direct assistance from our team.

Get MoreConvert Message Hub Pro →

Usage

  • Notification Page: View notifications in the WooCommerce My Account area (e.g., /my-account/moreconvert-messages) or a custom page.
  • Shortcodes:
    • Use [moreconvert_messages per_page="10"] to display notifications.
    • Use [moreconvert_messages_counter show_icon="1" counter_position="right"] to add a counter to menus or widgets.
  • Customization: Adjust notification types, page styles, and counter settings in the plugin’s admin panel.

Support

For help, visit our documentation or contact us at support@moreconvert.com. Check out our tutorials for setup guides.

Privacy Policy

Moreconvert Message Hub uses Appsero SDK to collect some telemetry data upon user’s confirmation. This helps us to troubleshoot problems faster & make product improvements.
Appsero SDK does not gather any data by default. The SDK only starts gathering basic telemetry data when a user allows it via the admin notice. We collect the data to ensure a great user experience for all our users.
Integrating Appsero SDK DOES NOT IMMEDIATELY start gathering data, without confirmation from users in any case.
Learn more about how Appsero collects and uses this data.

External Services

This plugin relies on the following third party/external services:
* Appsero: This plugin uses the Appsero SDK to collect basic telemetry data upon user confirmation. This data helps us troubleshoot problems faster and make product improvements. It sends non-sensitive telemetry data (such as WordPress version, PHP version, and plugin settings) to https://api.appsero.com. Privacy Policy
* icanhazip.com: As part of the Appsero SDK, the plugin may make a request to https://icanhazip.com/ to determine the server’s public IP address for analytical geolocation purposes. Privacy Policy

sections.installation:
Minimum Requirements

  • PHP 7.4 or greater is required (PHP 8.0 or greater is recommended)
  • WordPress 6.9 or greater

Automatic installation

Automatic installation is the easiest option — WordPress will handle the file transfer, and you won’t need to leave your web browser. To do an automatic install, log in to your WordPress dashboard, navigate to the Plugins menu, and click “Add New.”

In the search field type “Moreconvert Message Hub” then click “Search Plugins.” Once you’ve found us, you can view details about it such as the point release, rating, and description. Most importantly of course, you can install it by! Click “Install Now,” and WordPress will take it from there.

Manual installation

Manual installation method requires downloading the Moreconvert Message Hub plugin and uploading it to your web server via your favorite FTP application. The WordPress codex contains instructions on how to do this here.

Updating

Automatic updates should work smoothly, but we still recommend you back up your site.

If you encounter issues with the messages pages after an update, flush the permalinks by going to WordPress > Settings > Permalinks and hitting “Save.” That should return things to normal.

Sample data

  1. Navigate to MoreConvert Messages → General in your WordPress admin panel.
  2. Scroll down to the Test Data box.
  3. Press Generate Test Messages – the system will create one test message per active trigger.
  4. Review the generated messages.
  5. When you are done, press Delete Test Messages to clean up.
sections.faq:
Can I customize the notification page?

Absolutely! You can adjust colors, fonts, button styles, and layouts in the plugin settings. You can also choose to display notifications in the WooCommerce My Account area or a custom page.

How do I display notifications on my site?

Use the [moreconvert_messages] shortcode to display the notification list and [moreconvert_messages_counter] to show an unread notification counter.

Is the plugin compatible with multilingual sites?

Yes, it supports translations and is compatible with popular multilingual plugins.
